primary_route: Primary proposed optogenetic pathway-necessity test during cue retrieval; evaluate the actual illumination site, physiological validation and behavioral controls selected in the answer.

checks.reason: No explicit plan to consult prior detailed Methods/supplements or validated protocols before implementation and verify transfer of conditions. Generic calibration or a validated tool label does not meet M.
No executable construct/delivery quantities, functional dose, expression interval and preparation workflow or concrete procedure that resolves these settings.
No quantitative physiological acceptance/accuracy criterion, inhibition recovery validation or independently scored movement-detector calibration.
All randomized outcomes and omissions are retained, but missing/corrupted tracking/events and ambiguous choice measurements lack a specified handling rule.
Trial randomization and blinded scoring are explicit, but between-animal opsin/control allocation is not randomized or concealed by a specified procedure.
No actual multiplicity control or gatekeeping for the several timing, motor and sensory comparisons.

checks.quote: Increase only until terminal inhibition is verified
checks.reason: No bounded power/duration range or procedure deriving safe search bounds; stopping indefinite escalation alone does not define a bounded pilot.
Revised timing/illumination is not explicitly refrozen and confirmed using fresh independent data.
No complete linked raw video/event/calibration files and exact analysis/acquisition/version provenance.
